title: Missing `cachedInputTokens` for kimi-k2 on groq
body:
### Description

Was using the new Posthog llm analytics and found out cached tokens are not tracked for kimi k2 on groq. The actual response has the correct usage but ai sdk is not passing that.
https://console.groq.com/docs/prompt-caching#tracking-cache-usage

Probably missing here, will open a PR.

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/5c5fab361b8a8392c4d9b6083be67019fff9ec09/packages/groq/src/groq-chat-language-model.ts#L223-L227

### AI SDK Version

 "@ai-sdk/groq": "^2.0.4",
 "ai": "^5.0.28",

linked_prs.title: fix(provider/groq): track cached tokens usage
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Groq now supports prompt caching for kimi-k2, we were not tracking this in `usage`.

https://console.groq.com/docs/prompt-caching#tracking-cache-usage

## Summary

Added the correct response format handling for usage.

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
The issue involves missing tracking of cached input tokens for the kimi-k2 LLM model on Groq, which is an LLM provider integration and SDK parameter handling problem. This aligns with "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" and "LLM operation issues" in agent systems.
